search_text: published ZDI-23-1559 ZDI-CAN-21463 F5 BIG-IP OS unzip Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-10-18 CVE-2023-41373 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-41373 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['F5'] ['BIG-IP OS'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of F5 BIG-IP OS. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the unzip method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the apache user. F5 has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: F5 BIG-IP OS unzip Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of F5 BIG-IP OS. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the unzip method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the apache user.
